_meta.structure: Part C 108cp (18 units: 17 named + ONE of the four ENG480x Professional Practice units). Part D professional practice (ENG0001 Clayton / ENG0002 Malaysia, 0cp). Part E 36cp technical electives.
_meta.placementSource: Official Monash course progression map for 2025 commencing students, E3001 Bachelor of Engineering (Honours), page 10 (Robotics and mechatronics engineering). Supplied by Sahel 2026-09-16. Every Part C year/semester below is taken from that map, NOT inferred.
_meta.sharedWithElectrical: ECE2071, ECE2072, ECE2131, ECE3073, ENG2005, ENG4701, ENG4702 and ENG0001 are Part C units of BOTH this specialisation and Electrical. They live in electrical.json (ENG-prefixed ones tagged discipline:'common') and are NOT duplicated here. ENG2005, ENG4701, ENG4702 and ENG0001 carry an E3001 placements override there, because electrical.json defaults to the 5-year E3005 sequence.
sources: https://handbook.monash.edu/2025/aos/ROBMCTRN04 and /current/aos/ROBMCTRN04 — Part C/D/E unit lists. Verified IDENTICAL between the 2025 and current Handbook, so there is no vintage ambiguity for a 2025 commencing student.

https://handbook.monash.edu/current/units/{CODE} — every unit's title, credit points, offerings, requisite tree and enrolment rules pulled from the Handbook's own structured payload via scripts/harvest-handbook.mjs (not read off rendered prose). Per-unit sourceUrl and verifiedOn recorded on each entry.
Official 2025 E3001 course progression map PDF, page 10 — year/semester placement for every Part C unit.
openDecisions: CAMPUS ASSUMED CLAYTON. 11 Part E units in the Handbook's pool have NO Clayton offering (ENG0002, TRC2001, MMA3102, CHE4806, CHE4807, ECE4044, ECE4146, TRC4200, TRC4902, ECE5881, MEC3821) — Malaysia-only or not currently offered at all — so they are deliberately omitted. If this student is at Malaysia, this file is wrong and needs rebuilding with campus='Malaysia'.

ENG0002 (Industrial training) is the Part D requirement for MALAYSIA students; Clayton students do ENG0001 instead (already in the catalog as discipline:'common'). ENG0002 omitted for the same campus reason.

Part E slots are SUGGESTED, not map fact: the map only says 'engineering minor or level 3/4/5 technical elective' in six slots. Each elective's SEMESTER here is its real Clayton offering; which of the six slots it fills is the student's choice.
The Part E pool also allows an engineering MINOR (24cp) in place of electives — minors are not enumerated here.

Five Part E options (ECE2111, ECE2191, ECE3051, ECE3141, ECE3161) already exist in electrical.json tagged discipline:'electrical', so a student filtered to Mechatronics will not see them in the sidebar even though they are valid Part E choices.

ECE4045 (Network performance) is a valid Part E option but is NOT catalogued: its prerequisite is (ECE3141 OR ECE2041), and ECE3141 sits at Y4S1 in electrical.json, leaving no valid Year-4 Semester-1 slot for ECE4045 inside a 4-year E3001 degree. Add it as a custom unit if the sequence is worked out.
_meta.requisiteNote: Requisites are conjunctive GROUPS: prerequisiteText carries the full Handbook expression, and the prerequisites array lists ONE representative code per required AND-group. An earlier draft picked a single representative across the whole flattened rule, which silently dropped a required group on MMA3101 — caught by the validator's chronology check, now fixed in scripts/harvest-handbook.mjs.

units.title: Professional practice (Student teams)
units.notes: Part C Professional Practice: complete exactly ONE of ENG4801/4802/4803/4804, Year 4 Semester 2 per the official map. All four catalogued so you can choose. Enrolment rule: Prerequisite: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor course at Monash. Completion of 72 credit points. If you are enrolled in a non-engineering course, you must obtain written approval from your faculty before enrolling in the unit. Additional requirement: You must be a current member of an Engineering or IT student team during the semester of enrolment. Enrollees who are not current members of one of these teams will be discontinued from the unit ahead of each semester intake.

units.title: Professional practice (Industry experience)
units.notes: Part C Professional Practice: complete exactly ONE of ENG4801/4802/4803/4804, Year 4 Semester 2 per the official map. All four catalogued so you can choose. Enrolment rule: Prerequisite: Completion of 72 credit points of engineering studies. Additional requirement: You must apply through the Industry Experience application process . Recommendation: Completion of the Engineering Employability Skills Program is highly recommended prior to enrolling in this unit.

units.title: Professional practice (Co-operative education)
units.notes: Part C Professional Practice: complete exactly ONE of ENG4801/4802/4803/4804, Year 4 Semester 2 per the official map. All four catalogued so you can choose. Enrolment rule: Prerequisite: Completion of 72 credit points of engineering studies. For more details about registering your paid internship, please visit the Professional Practice page of the Engineering Co-Operative Education Program website. Both self-sourced and Monash-sourced internships are accepted. You do not need to be a part of the Co-op Program to be enrolled in this unit.
